title: 1 Chronicles 9
paragraphs: ⁹ ¹ All Israel was listed in the genealogical records, and these records are written in the book of the kings of Israel. The people of Judah were taken captive to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness. ² The first to resettle on their own land in their towns were some Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.

⁶ From the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and his relatives — six hundred ninety in all. ⁷ From the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hasenuah; ⁸ Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, son of Michri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah. ⁹ Their relatives, listed in their family records, numbered nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were clan leaders in their ancestral families.

¹¹ Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub — the administrator of the house of God. ¹² Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer. ¹³ Their relatives, who were heads of their ancestral families, numbered one thousand seven hundred and sixty — capable men for the work of serving in the house of God.

¹⁶ Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites. ¹⁷ The gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their fellow Levites. Shallum was their leader ¹⁸ and had served up to then as the gatekeeper at the King's Gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers of the Levite camps. ¹⁹ Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his fellow Korahites of his ancestral family were responsible for guarding the thresholds of the tent, as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the camp of the LORD. ²⁰ Phinehas son of Eleazar had been their supervisor in earlier times, and the LORD was with him.

²¹ Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the tent of meeting. ²² Altogether, those who were chosen as gatekeepers at the thresholds numbered two hundred and twelve. They were registered by genealogy in their villages, and David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their trusted positions. ²³ So they and their sons were in charge of the gates of the house of the LORD — the house of the tent — as guards. ²⁴ The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides: east, west, north, and south. ²⁵ And their relatives in their villages were required to come every seven days to serve with them,

²⁶ because these four chief gatekeepers, all Levites, held a position of trust and were responsible for the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God. ²⁷ They would spend the night around the house of God, because that responsibility was on them, and they were in charge of opening it every morning.

³¹ Mattithiah, a Levite and the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with the baking of the flat bread. ³² Some of their Kohathite relatives were responsible for preparing the bread set out on the table each Sabbath. ³³ These were the singers, heads of Levite families, who stayed in the rooms of the temple, free from other duties because they were responsible for their work day and night. ³⁴ All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs among their fellow Levites. They lived in Jerusalem.

³⁶ His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, and Nadab. ³⁷ Also Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth. ³⁸ Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem, near their own people. ³⁹ Ner became the father of Kish, Kish became the father of Saul, and Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal. ⁴⁰ Jonathan's son was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

⁴¹ The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz. ⁴² Ahaz became the father of Jarah; Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; Zimri became the father of Moza. ⁴³ Moza became the father of Binea; Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son. ⁴⁴ Azel had six sons, and their names were Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were Azel's sons.
